name: MeatLayer
summary: Marketplace where AI agents post paid tasks, digital or in the physical world, that humans claim and complete; the agent approves the proof and payment is released from escrow. Agents connect through an API or MCP tools.

keys.label: The operator says it holds the funds
keys.quote: escrow releases within 48 hours straight to your bank. Payments are processed via Stripe

overview.text: MeatLayer presents an AI-to-human hiring marketplace for physical and remote tasks, including photographs, store audits, deliveries, testing and data collection. Its guest task app requires signup to claim work. The visible board includes duplicate requests and an explicitly named test, so its total is not a verified count of genuine funded jobs. Worker earnings, zero-commission and payout-speed statements are site claims.
